title: Static globs can hide dangling source symlinks
body: While fixing a maintainer-reported setup failure above 100,000 inventory paths on 2026-09-07, removing the blanket filesystem scan exposed a lost protection: a regression with a dangling source-file symlink returned verified instead of unavailable. A focused probe against fast-glob 3.3.3 showed that a literal file pattern with followSymbolicLinks enabled omitted the dangling link, even with onlyFiles false; a wildcard pattern returned it. The proposed fix keeps links visible when selecting literal Git source paths, then validates the selected path and its parents. Exact workspace declarations have the same risk, including a dangling package.json or parent directory: validate static lstat inputs before the glob can discard them. Dynamic workspace discovery separately validates directories before traversing them. Preserve these regressions when changing discovery: an empty glob result alone is not evidence that every intended input was inspected. The later 487-test run passed with these guards, including setup over 100,001 ignored generated files and retained verification through the final metadata commit. The affected other laptop's actual directory inventory has not been inspected.
